Tourism Stopover Reason Names

Source: R/data.R
tourism_reason_name.Rd

A lookup table matching the stopover reason codes in tourism_reason to descriptive names.

Usage

tourism_reason_name

Format

A tibble with 7 rows and 2 variables: * **stop_reason**: Integer stopover reason code. * **name**: Descriptive name of the stopover reason.

References

Tourism Research Australia: https://www.tra.gov.au

See also

tourism_reason

Examples

data(tourism_reason_name)
tourism_reason_name
#> # A tibble: 7 × 2
#>   stop_reason name                          
#>         <int> <chr>                         
#> 1           1 Holiday                       
#> 2           2 Visiting friends and relatives
#> 3           3 Business                      
#> 4           6 Other reason                  
#> 5           7 No other reason               
#> 6           8 In transit                    
#> 7           9 Not stated/not asked
